```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Added tidyverse for dplyer and ggplot
library(tidyverse)

# Added data from kaggle csv
star_data <- read.csv("star_data.csv")

# Created csv for the star type names since the original csv only had the star type names in the description.
star_type_key <- read.csv("star_type_key.csv")

# Joined the two together so that we can have all of our data in one place
star_data <- star_data |> left_join(star_type_key, join_by(Star.type))
```
